generationInputs.prompt: The camera slowly pans from left to right, revealing a deep-sea diver in a detailed silver helmet and black suit, intently focused on his smartphone. Each time his fingers rapidly tap the screen, a burst of air bubbles streams upwards from his helmet, creating a mesmerizing trail in the dark, submerged environment. To his right, a vibrant, glowing blue seahorse, pulsating with electric tendrils, commands attention in the otherwise dark expanse. On a clear glass desk to his right sits a white desk lamp and a white office chair, both illuminated by the ethereal glow of the seahorse. The overall scene is moody and futuristic, with cool blue and silver tones dominating the color palette.
